processing.promptSummary: Extract each photographed purse, remove the source backdrop, weight sticker, and presentation box where present, preserve its visible silhouette, metalwork, stones, textiles, handles, straps, tassels, and fringe, apply restrained photographic enhancement, and composite it onto the exact DDA Silver warm-ivory catalog background.

products.title: Ornate Elephant and Floral Silver Purse

products.alt: Ornate silver purse with a curved handle and raised elephant and floral motifs
